scripts.db:migrate: node --env-file=server/.env server/src/scripts/prepare-database.js && node --env-file=server/.env ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: node --env-file=server/.env server/src/scripts/prepare-database.js && node --env-file=server/.env ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test:server: DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db node server/src/scripts/prepare-database.js && DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db node ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db node --test server/tests/*.test.js
